_comment: Local-engine turns (docs/Local-Engine-Turns.md): the codes the runtime writes, the controller keeps and Studio words, and one lane job's payload, named once. runtime-contracts (claude_code_lane.rs) checks NOT_READY_REASONS, RUNTIME_FAILURE_CODES and STOP_AND_SWEEP_FAILURE_CODES against notReadyReasons, runtimeFailureCodes and stopAndSweepFailureCodes. The controller keeps the first two as its own lists (runtime/register.rs, claude_code_lane.rs) and checks its stop and sweep codes against the third (claude_code_lane.rs, runtime/sweeps.rs); runtime-agent checks NotReadyReason and FailureCode (claude_code/mod.rs); Studio checks runtimes.ts, claudeCodeCopy.ts and claudeCodeTurnPresentation.ts. laneJobPayload is the payload agent::build_agent_job_payload writes for an admitted lane turn, the first in its chat: the controller's test a_lane_job_payload_is_the_one_runtime_contracts_records builds it the way dispatch does and compares, and runtime-agent's lane tests run it through LaneJob::of (claude_code/job.rs). Its ids are placeholders: <project_id>, <user_id> (the sender), <conversation_id>, <prompt_id>, <run_id>, <agent_id> (the sender's own @octo) and <runtime_id> (the computer the turn was admitted on).
